figurative_meaning_en: to survive or stay alive (barely managing)
similar_in_english: to hang on by a thread
example_sentences_in_bangla: গরিব পরিবারটি কোনোমতে খেয়ে পরে টিকে থাকছে।
অসুস্থতার পরও সে কীভাবে টিকে থাকল, বুঝতে পারছি না।
example_sentences_in_english: The poor family is barely surviving by eating whatever they can find.
I can't understand how he managed to stay alive after the illness.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural emphasis on resilience in the face of adversity in Bengali society.
